comment: The scored set every cleanup change is measured against (US-125). Every sentence is made up: no real dictation enters unless the person who said it agreed and it was rewritten without names or details. text is what the recognizer hands over. keep holds every fact that must survive, word for word as spoken, including the facts around a fix (a miss is lost content, the worst result). drop holds what must go (a miss is a stumble left in). A speaker's own contrast (the checkout page, not the pricing page) is a fine result; only the wrong statement must go. Phrases compare without punctuation and with number words as digits; a | separates accepted spellings. listLines is the fewest list lines a list case needs. unchanged means every word stays and the text stays prose. tuned marks a case close to an example inside a prompt, so the report shows a held out rate beside it. Never copy a case into a prompt. Run it with npm run probe:cleanup.
